hero.title: Authentic Sound. Beautiful Storytelling.
hero.tagline: Unheard and unscripted. Unpredictable. A home for the sonic adventures and the stories that linger long after the last note fades.

about.label: About
about.p1: Northwire is a sound-first podcast built for the deep listeners. Each episode is composed like a short film for the ears, layered field recordings, scored silence and voices that feel close enough to touch.
about.p2: No filler, no formula. Just honest conversation and immersive sound design, recorded in a dim studio and released whenever the story is ready.
